headline: Brazilian Luxury Furniture Manufacturer Kitchens Files for Judicial Recovery
summary: Brazilian custom luxury furniture brand Kitchens, founded in 1964, filed for judicial recovery amid operational difficulties and the closure of a business unit.
why: Judicial recovery filings by longstanding consumer brands highlight broader credit stress and consumer discretionary spending headwinds in Latin America's largest economy.

impacts.name: Brazilian Retail & Manufacturing
impacts.why: Insolvency proceedings disrupt supply contracts and signal financial strain in high-end furnishings.
